name: Animal Cruelty
overview: Scripture reveals that God has given mankind dominion over animals, entrusting them to care for and manage His creation responsibly (Genesis 1:28). This stewardship includes compassionate treatment, as shown by commands to help burdened animals (Exodus 23:5) and not to mistreat working animals, such as not muzzling an ox while it threshes grain (Deuteronomy 25:4). God's goodness extends to all His works, demonstrating His tender mercy over every living creature (Psalms 145:9), which calls believers to reflect His character in their dealings with animals.
